title: Correctness of the tester Gram-matrix construction program
preamble:
import Definitions.Def_ExpandingCodes_PolynomialStretch_BinaryRuntime

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped Classical
open NKtLB
formal_statement:
theorem ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGram.program_stops (d ell : ℕ) (h : 0<ell) (D M : ℕ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (y : Fin ((2^ell)^d) → Bool) (inp : Inputs) (s : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TapeStore (80+6*d) 3)
    (hc : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGram.Core d ell h D M y s) (hh : s.bufferHead 0=1)
    (hm : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TapeArrays.BottomMarked s 0) (hsp : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TapeArrays.BottomMarked s 1)
    (hdM : d*((2^ell)-1) ≤ M) (hhead : 1+(2^ell)^d*(2^ell) ≤ M)
    (hmatrix : (2^ell)^d*(2^ell)^d ≤ M) :
    ∃ t e,t ≤ ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGram.programTime d M ((2^ell)^d) ∧ (ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGram.program d).Stops inp (s.toCfg (ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGram.program d).entry) t e ∧
      ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGram.BuildState d ell h D M y s ((2^ell)^d*(2^ell)^d) e.store := by sorry
natural_statement: Starting from the tester core invariant and valid storage bounds, the explicit Gram-matrix construction program produces the complete specified build state within its stated polynomial time bound.
source: Algorithmic supporting lemma for Section 2 of Isaac M Hair and Amit Sahai, Expanding Codes with Polynomial Stretch; the explicit tape-machine implementation is formalized in ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGramCorrectness.
proof_route: The proof inducts through point, row, and matrix loops, using source field addition and multiplication to justify the stored entries and preservation properties.
solution_header:
theorem solution (d ell : ℕ) (h : 0<ell) (D M : ℕ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (y : Fin ((2^ell)^d) → Bool) (inp : Inputs) (s : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TapeStore (80+6*d) 3)
    (hc : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGram.Core d ell h D M y s) (hh : s.bufferHead 0=1)
    (hm : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TapeArrays.BottomMarked s 0) (hsp : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TapeArrays.BottomMarked s 1)
    (hdM : d*((2^ell)-1) ≤ M) (hhead : 1+(2^ell)^d*(2^ell) ≤ M)
    (hmatrix : (2^ell)^d*(2^ell)^d ≤ M) :
    ∃ t e,t ≤ ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGram.programTime d M ((2^ell)^d) ∧ (ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGram.program d).Stops inp (s.toCfg (ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGram.program d).entry) t e ∧
      ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGram.BuildState d ell h D M y s ((2^ell)^d*(2^ell)^d) e.store
solution_body:
by
  exact @ExpandingCodes.Computation.TesterGram.program_stops d ell h D M hM y inp s hc hh hm hsp hdM hhead hmatrix
